::: {#exr-10-anonymity-or-confidentiality-interactive}
## Anonymity or confidentiality?, interactive

Sort each statement to the term it describes. Then press **Check**.

```{=html}
<div class="grc-ex" data-type="sort">
<script type="application/json">
{
 "buckets": [
  {
   "id": "anon",
   "label": "Anonymity"
  },
  {
   "id": "conf",
   "label": "Confidentiality"
  }
 ],
 "chips": [
  {
   "t": "answers cannot be linked to persons — not even by the researcher",
   "b": "anon"
  },
  {
   "t": "the link exists but is protected and never revealed",
   "b": "conf"
  },
  {
   "t": "an anonymous online survey that collects no e-mail address",
   "b": "anon"
  },
  {
   "t": "recorded interviews with a separate key file (name ↔ P#)",
   "b": "conf"
  }
 ],
 "explain": "Promise only what you can keep: a recorded interview can be confidential, but it cannot be anonymous.",
 "ref": "sec-10-participants-rights",
 "reflabel": "Participants' rights"
}
</script>
</div>
```
:::

::: {#exr-10-the-consent-form-interactive}
## The consent form, interactive

Which requirement does each sentence meet? Then press **Check**.

```{=html}
<div class="grc-ex" data-type="sort">
<script type="application/json">
{
 "buckets": [
  {
   "id": "who",
   "label": "Who and purpose"
  },
  {
   "id": "what",
   "label": "What it involves"
  },
  {
   "id": "data",
   "label": "Data, storage, deletion"
  },
  {
   "id": "vol",
   "label": "Voluntariness, withdrawal"
  }
 ],
 "chips": [
  {
   "t": "\"We are three master's students investigating how developers handle security warnings.\"",
   "b": "who"
  },
  {
   "t": "\"Participation means one recorded interview of 30–45 minutes about your daily work.\"",
   "b": "what"
  },
  {
   "t": "\"Recordings are stored on university-approved storage, accessible to the group only, and deleted after transcription.\"",
   "b": "data"
  },
  {
   "t": "\"Participation is voluntary; you may withdraw at any time without giving a reason.\"",
   "b": "vol"
  }
 ],
 "explain": "SIKT provides consent-form templates — use them rather than writing your own from scratch.",
 "ref": "sec-10-worked-examples-and-tables",
 "reflabel": "Consent and anonymisation"
}
</script>
</div>
```
:::

::: {#exr-10-personal-data-interactive}
## Personal data?, interactive

Select the items that count as personal data. Then press **Check**.

```{=html}
<div class="grc-ex" data-type="pick">
<script type="application/json">
{
 "options": [
  {
   "t": "An e-mail address used to send the survey link",
   "ok": true
  },
  {
   "t": "An audio recording of an interview",
   "ok": true
  },
  {
   "t": "A job title plus company name in a small firm",
   "ok": true
  },
  {
   "t": "Aggregated counts of operating-system versions",
   "ok": false
  }
 ],
 "explain": "Personal data is any information relating to an identified or identifiable person — including indirect identification.",
 "ref": "sec-10-the-law",
 "reflabel": "The law"
}
</script>
</div>
```
:::
